description: Returns an owned vault job receipt (job_id/status); read the exact job with job_service.get_job for its public terminal outcome. Decrypt a sealed-box payload and store the plaintext in the local vault. Returns ok + plaintext fingerprint.
embedding_description: Receive sealed-box ciphertext from a peer solet, decrypt with local X25519 private key, store plaintext in local vault via the AES-256-GCM-at-rest path. Returns ok + one-way plaintext fingerprint to verify the transfer matches sender's. Plaintext never returned to caller. Use when accepting a credential hand-off from another solet. Registered execution returns job_id/status; the complete public outcome is in job.result. Secret operands remain volatile and failures are sanitized; uncertain effects require reconciliation, never automatic replay.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued vault job receipt. Completed public outcome: Import confirmation plus one-way plaintext fingerprint
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm ok=true and quote the plaintext_fingerprint. Do not retrieve or display the decrypted plaintext.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Compare the plaintext_fingerprint against the value returned by the sender's export_encrypted; they must match exactly. If they do not, the transfer was tampered with — delete the imported secret and ask the sender to re-export.
